ayahs.textArabic: اِذَا جَاۤءَكَ الْمُنٰفِقُوْنَ قَالُوْا نَشْهَدُ اِنَّكَ لَرَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ ۘوَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ اِنَّكَ لَرَسُوْلُهٗ ۗوَاللّٰهُ يَشْهَدُ اِنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ لَكٰذِبُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Iżā jā'akal-munāfiqūna qālū nasyhadu innaka larasūlullāh(i), wallāhu ya‘lamu innaka larasūluh(ū), wallāhu yasyhadu innal-munāfiqīna lakāżibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: WHEN THE HYPOCRITES come unto thee, they say, "We bear witness that thou art indeed God's Apostle!" But God knows that thou art truly His Apostle; and He bears witness that the hypocrites are indeed false [in their declaration of faith].

ayahs.textArabic: اِتَّخَذُوْٓا اَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّهُمْ سَاۤءَ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ittakhażū aimānahum junnatan faṣaddū ‘an sabīlillāh(i), innahum sā'a mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They have made their oaths a cover [for their falseness], and thus they turn others away from the Path of God. Evil indeed is all that they are wont to do:

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ اٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوْا فَطُبِعَ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika bi'annahum āmanū ṡumma kafarū faṭubi‘a ‘alā qulūbihim fahum lā yafqahūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: this, because [they profess that] they have attained to faith, whereas [inwardly] they deny the truth - and so, a seal has been set on their hearts so that they can no longer understand [what is true and what false].

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ اَجْسَامُهُمْۗ وَاِنْ يَّقُوْلُوْا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْۗ  كَاَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ  ۗيَحْسَبُوْنَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْۗ هُمُ الْعَدُوُّ فَاحْذَرْهُمْۗ قَاتَلَهُمُ اللّٰهُ ۖاَنّٰى يُؤْفَكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ra'aitahum tu‘jibuka ajsāmuhum, wa iy yaqūlū tasma‘ liqaulihim, ka'annahum khusyubum musannadah(tun), yaḥsabūna kulla ṣaiḥatin ‘alaihim, humul-‘aduwwu faḥżarhum, qātalahumullāh(u), annā yu'fakūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now when thou seest them, their outward appearance may please thee; and when they speak, thou art inclined to lend ear to what they say. [But though they may seem as sure of themselves] as if they were timbers [firmly] propped up, they think that every shout is [directed] against them. They are the [real] enemies [of all faith], so beware of them. [They deserve the imprecation,] "May God destroy them!" How perverted are their minds!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ لَوَّوْا رُءُوْسَهُمْ وَرَاَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّوْنَ وَهُمْ مُّسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā qīla lahum ta‘ālau yastagfir lakum rasūlullāhi lawwau ru'ūsahum wa ra'aitahum yaṣuddūna wa hum mustakbirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, when they are told, "Come, the Apostle of God will pray [unto God] that you be forgiven", they turn their heads away, and thou canst see how they draw back in their false pride.

ayahs.textArabic: سَوَاۤءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ اَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْۗ  لَنْ يَّغْفِرَ اللّٰهُ لَهُمْۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْفٰسِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Sawā'un ‘alaihim astagfarta lahum am lam tastagfir lahum, lay yagfirallāhu lahum, innallāha lā yahdil-qaumal-fāsiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for them it is all the same whether thou dost pray that they be forgiven or dost not pray for them: God will nor forgive them - for, behold, God does not bestow His guidance upon such iniquitous folk.

ayahs.textArabic: هُمُ الَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ لَا تُنْفِقُوْا عَلٰى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ حَتّٰى يَنْفَضُّوْاۗ وَلِلّٰهِ خَزَاۤىِٕنُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۙ وَلٰكِنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ لَا يَفْقَهُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Humul-lażīna yaqūlūna lā tunfiqū ‘alā man ‘inda rasūlillāhi ḥattā yanfaḍḍū, wa lillāhi khazā'inus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa lākinnal-munāfiqīna lā yafqahūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is they who say [to their compatriots], "Do not spend anything on those who are with God's Apostle, so that they [may be forced to] leave." However, unto God belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth: but this truth the hypocrites cannot grasp.

ayahs.textArabic: يَقُوْلُوْنَ لَىِٕنْ رَّجَعْنَآ اِلَى الْمَدِيْنَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْاَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْاَذَلَّ ۗوَلِلّٰهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُوْلِهٖ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَلٰكِنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yaqūlūna la'ir raja‘nā ilal-madīnati layukhrijannal-a‘azzu minhal-ażall(a), wa lillāhil-‘izzatu wa lirasūlihī wa lil-mu'minīna wa lākinnal-munāfiqīna lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] they say, "Indeed, when we return to the City [we,] the ones most worthy of honour will surely drive out therefrom those most contemptible ones!" However, all honour belongs to God, and [thus] to His Apostle and those who believe [in God]: but of this the hypocrites are not aware.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ اَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَادُكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ ۚوَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā tulhikum amwālukum wa lā aulādukum ‘an żikrillāh(i), wa may yaf‘al żālika fa ulā'ika humul-khāsirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Let not your worldly goods or your children make you oblivious of the remembrance of God: for If any behave thus - it is they, they who are the losers!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنْفِقُوْا مِنْ مَّا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَ اَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُوْلَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ اَخَّرْتَنِيْٓ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ قَرِيْبٍۚ فَاَصَّدَّقَ وَاَكُنْ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anfiqū mimmā razaqnākum min qabli ay ya'tiya aḥadakumul-mautu fa yaqūla rabbi lau lā akhkhartanī ilā ajalin qarīb(in), fa aṣṣaddaqa wa akum minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And spend on others out of what We have provided for you as sustenance, ere there come a time when death approaches any of you, and he then says, "O my Sustainer! If only Thou wouldst grant me a delay for a short while, so that I could give in charity and be among the righteous!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَنْ يُّؤَخِّرَ اللّٰهُ نَفْسًا اِذَا جَاۤءَ اَجَلُهَاۗ وَاللّٰهُ خَبِيْرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lay yu'akhkhirallāhu nafsan iżā jā'a ajaluhā, wallāhu khabīrum bimā ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But never does God grant a delay to a human being when his term has come; and God is fully aware of all that you do.
